title: fix(app-shell): the console-made tab of a view-less object keeps toolbar changes for the session (objectui#11643)
body:
Fixes #11643

Clause-②: no

## What changed

On an object that declares no list view, `buildViewTabs` pushes a tab the console makes itself: "All Records", id `all`. Its toolbar changes took the overlay branch of `persistViewPatch` like a served view's and were sent as `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/all` with no `viewKind`. The door refused them (`422 INVALID_METADATA`), an error toast appeared, and the change was gone on reload.

Triage's ruling (comment `5988346142`) chose "not offered as saved": the tab's toolbar changes apply for the session and send no metadata write, and no view is created to hold them.

`packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx`:

- The views memo marks the tab where it builds it (`fallbackTab`) with a module-local symbol, `CONSOLE_MADE_TAB`. It is not exported. A symbol key rides every spread of the tab the page takes, and `Object.entries`, `Object.keys` and `JSON.stringify` skip it, so it never reaches a request body.
- `persistViewPatch` returns before it schedules anything (no read, no PUT, no toast) when the tab carries the mark and no stored row backs it. "Stored row" is `isSavedViewId`, the classification the write below it already uses.
- One rule covers every control that reaches `persistViewPatch`: density, sort (the schema's and the list's callback), hidden fields, column order and widths (both callbacks), and inline edit. The list keeps each change in its own state, so it applies for the session.
- The tab is told apart by where it was made, not by its id. A served view whose tab id is also `all`, a saved view beside the console's tab, and a stored row named `all` that shadows that tab all keep their save path.

No export, prop, exported type member or i18n key is added to any `@object-ui/*` package. There is no server-side change. The served-view and saved-view save paths are unchanged.

## Measured

### Live before and after

Backend: objectstack `main` `27991556`, `examples/app-showcase`, `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`, built in a separate worktree. Two consoles ran against that one backend: base `531b26c` and this branch. A headless Chromium logged in as the seeded admin, clicked the toolbar's Density button, recorded every `/meta/view` request and answer, read the toasts and the console errors, and reloaded the page.

`showcase_account` declares no view: `GET /api/v1/meta/view?object=showcase_account` answers `items: []`, and its object document carries no `listViews` and no `list`. The only tab is "All Records".

| | base `531b26c` | this branch |
|---|---|---|
| Density after the click | `Density: Comfortable`, row 41 to 45 px | `Density: Comfortable`, row 41 to 45 px |
| Writes to `/meta/view` | `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/all`, body `{"rowHeight":"medium","object":"showcase_account","name":"all","_isOverride":true}` | none |
| Answer | `422`, `INVALID_METADATA`, "Unrecognized key(s) on this view container: `rowHeight`, `_isOverride`" | none sent |
| Toast | "Failed to save" with the door's message | none |
| Console | `[ObjectView] Failed to persist view config: ...` | none |
| After reload | `Density: Compact` | `Density: Compact` (session-only, as ruled) |

The served view `showcase_task.default` still saves on this branch. The click sent `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task.default` and got `200`, and after reload the button read `Density: Comfortable` (45 px). Base did the same: `PUT` answered `200`, and the density survived the reload.

### Pins

New file: `ObjectView.fallbackTabSessionOnly-11643.test.tsx`. It reuses the objectui#11642 harness: the real page, the real `persistViewPatch` with its debounce, and the real `ObjectStackAdapter` over a store that judges each `PUT` with the spec's `ViewMetadataSchema`.

1. On the console-made tab of a view-less object, each of the eight callbacks that reach `persistViewPatch` sends no `updateViewConfig`, no `saveItem` and no `getItem`, and raises no toast and no persist error.
2. A saved view beside that tab: the console tab still sends nothing. The saved view's density change is written (`isSavedView: true`) and survives a reload.
3. A served view whose tab id is `all` (a bare key in the object's own `listViews`) keeps its overlay save path (`isSavedView: false`), composes with its stored overlay, and survives a reload.
4. A stored row named `all` that shadows the console-made tab is a saved row. Its write is sent (`isSavedView: true`) and survives a reload.

### Reverse verification

Run on the committed fix (`80b203a`) through `ablation-replace.mjs`. That tool checked the anchor count, checked that the blob changed, and restored the file to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty after each leg.

| Mutation of the guard | Red | Green |
|---|---|---|
| removed | 1, 2 | 3, 4 |
| keyed on `viewIdLocal === 'all'` | 3, 4 | 1, 2 |
| `isSavedViewId` clause dropped | 4 | 1, 2, 3 |

With the guard removed, case 1 failed on its write count. The one coalesced write it caught was `updateViewConfig('track_note', 'all', { rowHeight, sort, inlineEdit, columnState }, { isSavedView: false })`. `hiddenFields` was not in it, because `persistHiddenFields` already kept that toggle session-only on a tab that declares no columns. The prediction for that leg named case 1 only. Case 2 also went red, because its first half drives the console-made tab. The test header records the measured direction.

### Gates

All local gates ran on head `bd7343f`, which is `80b203a` plus a test-header commit plus a merge of `origin/main` `0baf86f`. That merge does not touch `ObjectView.tsx`. The live run and the reverse verification ran on `80b203a`. Exit codes are below.

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/` (repo root, under the shared verify lock): exit 0. `Test Files 1005 passed | 1 skipped (1006)` and `Tests 9979 passed | 9 skipped (9988)`. `vitest list --filesOnly` counts the same 1006 files, the new one among them.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`, after the `@object-ui/app-shell^...` closure build: exit 0. The script echoes `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, and `--listFilesOnly` on `tsconfig.test.json` includes the new test file.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell lint`: exit 0, with 0 errors. Every warning is `no-explicit-any`, and the new test file's warnings follow the objectui#11642 harness it copies.
- Root scripts, each exit 0: `check-object-metadata-write-doors`, `check-new-cross-file-line-citations`, `check-control-bytes`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-claims`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check-pending-changeset-literals`, `check-vi-mock-specifiers`, `check-vi-mock-inherit`, `check-vi-mock-override-shape`, `check-test-path-roots`, `check-type-check-coverage`, `check-unreferenced-sources`, `check-i18n-call-site-keys` and `check-handler-key-read-sites`.
- CI runs the full farm. This list covers only what the diff touches.

Changeset: `.changeset/11643-fallback-tab-session-only.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell` `patch`.

## Acceptance notes

- Hidden fields: before this change, `persistHiddenFields` already returned early on the console-made tab, because the tab declares no `columns` and no row backs it. The new rule covers that toggle as well, so all five controls answer to one rule. The early return in `persistHiddenFields` itself is unchanged.
- A served view called `all` exists in no example. CRM declares `listViews.all` on `crm_lead`, `crm_activity` and `crm_opportunity`, but the spec's `expandViewContainer` names those `crm_lead.all` and so on (measured for `crm_lead`). `ViewItemNameSchema` requires a dotted name, so a served ViewItem cannot be named a bare `all`. A bare `all` tab id can only come from an object document's own `listViews`. Pin 3 covers that case.
- Noted, not filed, not measured live: a served tab built from a bare key in an object document's own `listViews` carries no `viewKind`. Its first overlay `PUT` depends on the door inheriting one from a registry entry of the same name. No example has such an object, so this was not exercised live. Pin 3 seeds a stored overlay that carries `viewKind`. Carrier: none.

The session that wrote this is `https://claude.ai/code/session_015W8GBu6sBiqus2L2xjMsAL`.
